protocol.title: Quantitative Multiparameter Measuring of Dynamic Single-Cell Immune Responses
protocol.source: EMBC 2014 (IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Conference)
protocol.platform: Custom PDMS microfluidic device with single-cell trapping chambers and on-chip bead-based fluorescent sandwich assay
protocol.objective: Simultaneous dynamic measurement of NF-kB nuclear translocation, cytokine/protein secretion, cell migration, and morphology in single macrophages stimulated with arbitrary temporal profiles of LPS and TNF

device.configuration: Single-cell isolation chambers with on-chip bead assay zone
device.channel_description: Serpentine trapping channel with distinct single-cell chambers
device.flow_control: Upstream microfluidic valve actuation for arbitrary temporal stimulus delivery

reagents.culture_media: DMEM or RPMI supplemented with FBS

bead_assay.wash_reagent: Wash buffer (to remove unbound detection antibody)

nfkb_reporter.readout: Nuclear/cytoplasmic fluorescence ratio per cell per frame

steps.name: Device priming
steps.notes: Two PBS washes combined to flush channels, remove air bubbles, and passivate PDMS surfaces to minimise non-specific cell adhesion. Low flow rate (~1 nL/s).

steps.name: Hydrodynamic single-cell loading and trapping
steps.operation: flow-through trap (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.notes: Cells loaded at low flow rate into serpentine trapping channel. Custom trap geometry isolates single cells in distinct chambers. BioScript mix abstracts channel-flow hydrodynamic trapping; no bulk DMF electrode mixing occurs at this step. Trapping efficiency verified by bright-field imaging.

steps.name: Channel wash to remove untrapped cells
steps.notes: PBS flush through channels removes excess untrapped cells. Only single cells retained in trapping chambers proceed. Maintains low background for imaging.

steps.name: Pre-stimulus baseline imaging
steps.notes: 15-min baseline incubation at 37 C before stimulation. Bright-field and GFP fluorescence images acquired at t=0. NF-kB-GFP baseline: cytoplasmic (inactive state). Cell centroid coordinates and morphology descriptors logged as pre-stimulus reference.

steps.name: LPS stimulus delivery (brief pulse)
steps.notes: LPS delivered as a short pulse via valve-controlled flow switching. Mimics transient pathogen-associated molecular pattern encounter. Pulse duration tunable from seconds to minutes via valve control. Triggers TLR4-mediated NF-kB activation.

steps.name: TNF stimulus delivery (prolonged exposure)
steps.notes: TNF delivered as a prolonged sustained input following LPS pulse. Models cytokine-driven reactivation of NF-kB (second activation wave). Sequential LPS then TNF delivery allows independent characterisation of PAMP-triggered vs. cytokine-triggered NF-kB dynamics in the same single cell.

steps.name: Dynamic NF-kB fluorescence imaging and multiparameter observation
steps.readout: Nuclear/cytoplasmic GFP ratio per cell per frame
steps.notes: NF-kB-GFP nuclear translocation monitored in real time across the full 4-hour (240m) observation window. Nuclear masks generated by segmentation; N/C ratio computed per frame. Same image series simultaneously analysed for migration and morphology (non-destructive). nfkbActivationDetection module abstracts: fluorescence acquisition, nuclear segmentation, N/C ratio, migration vector extraction, and morphology descriptor calculation.

steps.name: Periodic conditioned medium sampling
steps.notes: Supernatant periodically collected from single-cell chamber at defined time intervals throughout stimulation window. Non-destructive: fresh media returned after each sample to maintain cell viability. Provides time-resolved secretion data matched to NF-kB activation and migration traces of the same cell.

steps.name: On-chip bead-based cytokine capture (sandwich assay - Step 1)
steps.notes: Antibody-conjugated capture beads mixed with conditioned medium sample in on-chip assay zone. Secreted proteins captured on bead surface during 60-min incubation at room temperature. Multiple cytokines assayed simultaneously via spectrally distinct bead populations (multiplexed). No cell destruction or removal required.

steps.name: Detection antibody addition (sandwich assay - Step 2)
steps.notes: Fluorescent secondary detection antibody added to complete sandwich immunoassay complex. Binds captured secreted proteins on beads. 30-min incubation at 25 C. Fluorescence intensity per bead cluster proportional to secreted protein concentration. Quantitative against standard curve.

steps.name: Bead assay wash
steps.notes: Wash buffer removes excess unbound fluorescent detection antibody to reduce background signal. Critical for quantitative accuracy at single-cell secretion levels (pM to nM range). 5-min wash step.

steps.name: Fluorescence detection of cytokine secretion
steps.notes: On-chip fluorescence imaging of bead assay zone. cytokineSecretionDetection module abstracts: bead cluster fluorescence acquisition, bead segmentation, per-channel intensity quantification, multi-cytokine spectral demultiplexing, and concentration calibration. Result: quantitative secreted protein levels per single cell per time point.

stimulus_input_space.temporal_profiles: Arbitrary; ranging from brief pulses (seconds) to prolonged inputs (hours)
stimulus_input_space.delivery_method: Upstream microfluidic valve actuation with programmable switching
stimulus_input_space.notes: Dynamic input space mimics physiological stimulus variability. Same temporal profiles applied to all trapped single cells simultaneously via upstream channel control.

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Device priming, cell trapping, wash, baseline imaging, LPS pulse, TNF exposure, NF-kB imaging and detection

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose nfkbSignal; secretion assay branch begins

bioscript_notes.ir_output: 7 basic blocks (BB1-BB7), 2 if/else gates, 8 CFG edges
bioscript_notes.duration_units: All durations converted to seconds (s) or minutes (m) for compiler compatibility (BioScript supports s and m only; h token not supported). 240 min imaging window -> 240m (IR: 14400.0 SECOND). 60 min bead capture -> 60m (IR: 3600.0 SECOND). 30 min detection antibody -> 30m (IR: 1800.0 SECOND).
bioscript_notes.trapping_abstraction: mix statements in Steps 2 and 3 abstract hydrodynamic single-cell trapping and channel-flow wash events. No DMF electrode mixing occurs at these steps.
bioscript_notes.heat_abstraction: heat statements model temperature-controlled incubation at 37 C (cell culture and imaging window) and 25 C (room-temperature bead assay steps). Baseline hold at 37 C for 15 min (900 s) before stimulation.
bioscript_notes.ascii_constraint: All comment text restricted to ASCII characters (ANTLR4 FileStream reads as ASCII). Non-ASCII characters (e.g. diacritics) will cause UnicodeDecodeError at compile time.
